div.div:
ACL SECURITY MODEL SPECIFICATION
• Enforcement Point: Centralized Ingress on Core SVI Gateways.
• Default Stance: Explicit Whitelist; Implicit Deny All.
• Stateful Boundary: Perimeter ASA handles NAT & Egress Inspection.
• Lateral Defense: Workstation-to-Workstation traffic blocked.
• Audit Trail: Matches logged via Core Syslog daemon.

div.div:
RECONCILIATION AUDIT (CHANGE-001)
• VLAN Migration: DEV-PC-01 re-anchored from F1 (VLAN 30) to F2 (VLAN 10).
• Policy Verified: ACL_DEV_IN permits TCP/22 to 10.10.60.21.
• Isolation Verified: Lateral attempts to VLAN 40 & 80 dropped.
• Status: 100% Policy Conformance Verified in Lab.
